name: Black Knight
source:
"...If you intend to get in my way than that's enough of a reason to kill you. Fall into Hell."

A loyal subordinate of the king of Odense who serves him with absolute power.
On the King's order he spearheaded the attack on Thumbelina's village.
He has a callous personality and could even easily kill his own subordinates.
